tools.name: openrouter_get_current_key
tools.description: Get the API key this connection uses: its label, spend and remaining limit, budgets, expiry, free-tier status and data regions. A good first call to check the connection. OpenRouter API: GET /key.

tools.name: openrouter_get_credits
tools.description: Get the account's total credits purchased and used. Needs a MANAGEMENT key (a normal API key gets HTTP 401 or 403). OpenRouter API: GET /credits.

tools.name: openrouter_get_activity
tools.description: Get account activity grouped by endpoint for the last 30 completed UTC days: requests, tokens and spend. May need a MANAGEMENT key (HTTP 401 or 403 otherwise). OpenRouter API: GET /activity.

tools.name: openrouter_list_keys
tools.description: List the API keys on the account, with usage and limits. Needs a MANAGEMENT key (a normal API key gets HTTP 401 or 403). OpenRouter API: GET /keys.

tools.name: openrouter_get_key
tools.description: Get one API key by its hash (from openrouter_list_keys): usage, limit, expiry and budgets. Needs a MANAGEMENT key. OpenRouter API: GET /keys/{hash}.

tools.name: openrouter_list_guardrails
tools.description: List the guardrails (spend and provider rules for keys and members). Needs a MANAGEMENT key. OpenRouter API: GET /guardrails.

tools.name: openrouter_get_guardrail
tools.description: Get one guardrail by id (from openrouter_list_guardrails). Needs a MANAGEMENT key. OpenRouter API: GET /guardrails/{id}.

tools.name: openrouter_get_generation
tools.description: Get the request and usage metadata of one past generation: model, provider, tokens, cost and latency. The id comes from the response of an earlier call (x-generation-id). OpenRouter API: GET /generation?id=.

tools.name: openrouter_get_generation_content
tools.description: Get the stored prompt, completion and error text of one past generation. Only works when the account stored that content (logging on). OpenRouter API: GET /generation/content?id=.

tools.name: openrouter_list_models
tools.description: List the models OpenRouter offers: context length, prices per token, supported parameters and modalities. Filter with q, modalities or supported parameters. OpenRouter API: GET /models.

tools.name: openrouter_list_models_for_account
tools.description: List the models this API key may use, after the account's provider and privacy settings and guardrails. Text output models by default. OpenRouter API: GET /models/user.

tools.name: openrouter_count_models
tools.description: Get the total number of models OpenRouter offers, optionally by output modality. OpenRouter API: GET /models/count.

tools.name: openrouter_get_model
tools.description: Get the full details of one model by its author and slug, for example openai and gpt-4o. Variant suffixes such as :free work. OpenRouter API: GET /model/{author}/{slug}.

tools.name: openrouter_list_model_endpoints
tools.description: List the provider endpoints that serve one model, with each provider's price, context length, uptime and latency. OpenRouter API: GET /models/{author}/{slug}/endpoints.

tools.name: openrouter_list_providers
tools.description: List the upstream model providers OpenRouter routes to (name, slug, data policy links). OpenRouter API: GET /providers.

tools.name: openrouter_list_embedding_models
tools.description: List the embedding models OpenRouter offers with their properties. OpenRouter API: GET /embeddings/models.
